title: 不定式 to do 的基本用法（作主语/宾语/宾语补足语）
knowledgePoint: 不定式 to do 作主语的结构（直接作主语/it作形式主语）、作宾语的动词搭配（want/hope/decide等）、作宾语补足语的用法（ask/tell/encourage等+宾语+to do）、不定式的否定形式（not to do）、省略to的特殊情况

questions.question: ______ sustainable development goals requires global cooperation, and it is crucial ______ all countries to take practical actions.
questions.explanation: 第一空“实现可持续发展目标”作主语，用不定式To achieve（直接作主语）；第二空“it is crucial for sb. to do”是固定结构，it作形式主语，真正主语是to take practical actions，for表“对某人来说”，符合用法。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 不定式作主语时，常用it作形式主语（it is+adj.+for/of sb. to do），避免句子头重脚轻；直接作主语多见于书面语，强调动作本身。

questions.question: The manager asked the team to submit the report before Friday and not delay the progress. Everyone promised to complete their tasks on time.
questions.explanation: 不定式的否定形式需在to前加not，“not delay”应为“not to delay”，题干省略了to，语法错误；“asked sb. to do”和“promised to do”的用法正确，仅否定式有误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 不定式否定结构：not+to+动词原形（如tell sb. not to do 告诉某人不要做），否定词不能直接加在动词前。

questions.question: She hopes ______ a scholarship to study abroad, as she has been dreaming ______ in a world-class university since childhood.
questions.explanation: hope后接不定式to do作宾语（hope to win 希望赢得），不能接动名词；dream后可接of doing或to do，此处to study与前文hope to win结构一致，表“梦想去顶尖大学学习”，符合搭配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 常见接不定式作宾语的动词：hope/want/decide/plan/agree/offer等，需牢记固定搭配。

questions.question: It is important for young people to develop critical thinking skills—these skills help them to make wise decisions in daily life.
questions.explanation: 第一空“it is important for sb. to do”是形式主语结构，不定式to develop作真正主语；第二空“help sb. (to) do”中to可省略，help them (to) make用法正确，语法连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: help后接宾语补足语时，不定式的to可省略（help sb. do），也可保留（help sb. to do），两者均符合语法规则。

questions.question: The teacher encouraged her students ______ their own opinions bravely and advised them ______ afraid of making mistakes.
questions.explanation: encourage后接不定式作宾语补足语（encourage sb. to do 鼓励某人做）；advise后接不定式作宾语补足语（advise sb. not to do 建议某人不要做），not to be afraid符合否定式规则。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 常见接“宾语+to do”作宾补的动词：encourage/ask/tell/order/invite/teach等，否定形式均为“宾语+not to do”。

questions.question: He decided to not attend the meeting because he had to deal with an urgent matter. His colleague agreed to take his place and convey his ideas.
questions.explanation: 不定式否定词not需放在to前，“to not attend”应为“not to attend”，题干否定词位置错误；“decided to do”和“agreed to do”的用法正确，仅否定式有误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 不定式的否定词not必须置于to之前，形成“not to do”结构，不能写成“to not do”，这是核心语法规则。

questions.question: ______ well in the interview, she spent a lot of time researching the company and practicing ______ professional questions.
questions.explanation: 第一空“为了在面试中表现好”作目的状语，用不定式To perform；第二空“practice后接动名词作宾语（practice doing 练习做），answering professional questions符合搭配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 不定式可作目的状语，表“为了……”；practice/finish/enjoy/avoid等动词后接动名词，不能接不定式。

questions.question: It is kind of her to help strangers in need—she often offers to share her knowledge and experience with others.
questions.explanation: “it is kind of sb. to do”是固定结构，of用于修饰人的品质（kind/nice/foolish等）；“offers to share”中不定式作宾语，用法正确，语法连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: it is+adj.+for/of sb. to do 的区别：of修饰人的内在品质，for表动作对某人的影响（如it is important for you to study 对你来说学习很重要）。

questions.question: The company plans ______ a new branch in the south, and they expect ______ more job opportunities for local people.
questions.explanation: plan后接不定式作宾语（plan to open 计划开设）；expect后接不定式作宾语（expect to create 期望创造），均符合“动词+to do”的固定搭配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 部分动词后只能接不定式作宾语，不能接动名词，常见的有plan/expect/want/hope/decide等，需重点记忆。

questions.question: My parents told me to not stay up late and to keep a healthy lifestyle. I promised them to follow their advice strictly.
questions.explanation: “told me to not stay up”应为“told me not to stay up”，不定式否定词not需放在to前，题干否定词位置错误；其余部分用法正确，仅否定式有误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 无论主语是第几人称，“动词+宾语+to do”的否定形式均为“动词+宾语+not to do”，否定词位置固定。

questions.question: ______ the truth to the public is necessary, but it is difficult ______ people’s reactions in advance.
questions.explanation: 第一空“向公众告知真相”作主语，用不定式To tell（直接作主语）；第二空“it is difficult to do”是形式主语结构，to predict作真正主语，符合用法。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 不定式和动名词均可作主语，不定式更侧重“具体的、未发生的动作”，动名词更侧重“抽象的、习惯性的动作”，此处表具体动作，用不定式更合适。

questions.question: She agreed to help us prepare for the event and promised to bring all the necessary materials. We are grateful for her support.
questions.explanation: “agreed to help”和“promised to bring”均为“动词+to do”作宾语，用法正确；“help us prepare”中省略to，符合help的宾补用法，语法连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: agree/promise/refuse等动词后只能接不定式作宾语，不能接动名词或“宾语+to do”，需区分“作宾语”与“作宾补”的不同场景。

questions.question: The doctor advised him ______ less sugar and ______ more exercise to improve his health. He decided ______ the advice seriously.
options: to eat; to do; to follow
questions.correctAnswer: to eat; to do; to follow
questions.explanation: advise后接“宾语+to do”作宾补（advise him to eat 建议他少吃）；第二空to do与to eat并列，省略advise him，避免重复；decide后接不定式作宾语（decide to follow 决定遵循），符合搭配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 多个不定式并列时，后续不定式的to可省略（如ask him to sit and wait 让他坐下等），但强调每个动作时可保留to。

questions.question: It is necessary for the government to take measures to protect the environment. Citizens also have a responsibility to contribute their efforts.
questions.explanation: 第一空“it is necessary for sb. to do”是形式主语结构，to take measures作真正主语；第二空“have a responsibility to do”中不定式作定语，修饰responsibility，用法正确，语法连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 不定式可作定语，修饰名词（如a chance to go 去的机会、a responsibility to do 做某事的责任），表“做某事的……”。

questions.question: They invited her ______ the opening ceremony and requested her ______ a short speech on environmental protection.
questions.explanation: invite后接“宾语+to do”作宾补（invite her to attend 邀请她参加）；request后接“宾语+to do”作宾补（request her to give 要求她发表），均符合固定搭配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: invite/request/order/command等动词后接“宾语+to do”，不能接动名词，否定形式为“宾语+not to do”。

questions.question: He wants to not only finish the project on time but also ensure its quality. His team is working hard to achieve this goal.
questions.explanation: “wants to not only finish”应为“wants not only to finish”，not only...but also...连接不定式时，to需放在not only之后，题干语序错误；其余部分用法正确，仅语序有误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: not only...but also...连接并列不定式时，结构为“not only to do but also (to) do”，to需置于not only之后，后续to可省略。

questions.question: ______ is important for children ______ independent thinking from an early age. Parents should allow them ______ their own choices.
questions.explanation: 第一空it作形式主语，真正主语是to develop independent thinking；第二空“allow sb. to do”作宾补（allow them to make 允许他们做），符合“it is+adj.+for sb. to do”和“allow+宾语+to do”的搭配规则。
questions.knowledgeExtension: allow后接“宾语+to do”，不能接动名词（如allow doing 允许做某事，无宾语时），需区分“接宾语”与“不接宾语”的用法。

questions.question: The boss ordered the employees to complete the task before the end of the month and not to make any mistakes. Everyone tried their best to meet the requirement.
questions.explanation: “ordered the employees to complete”和“not to make”均符合“动词+宾语+to do”的肯定与否定形式；“tried their best to meet”中不定式作目的状语，用法正确，语法连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: order/command等命令类动词后接“宾语+to do”，否定形式为“宾语+not to do”，语气强硬，符合语境。

questions.question: She dreams ______ a famous writer and has been practicing ______ every day. Her teacher encourages her ______ her dream.
options: to be; to write; to pursue
questions.explanation: dream后接不定式to be作宾语（dream to be 梦想成为）；practice后接动名词writing作宾语（practice writing 练习写作）；encourage后接“宾语+to do”作宾补（encourage her to pursue 鼓励她追求），均符合搭配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: dream后可接to do或of doing，含义相近；practice/keep/continue等动词后只能接动名词，不能接不定式。

questions.question: It is foolish of him to ignore the warning and to take such a big risk. He will regret not to listen to others’ advice.
questions.explanation: “regret not to listen”应为“regret not listening”，regret后接动名词表“后悔做过某事”，接不定式表“遗憾要做某事”，此处表“后悔没听建议”，需用动名词；“it is foolish of him to do”用法正确，仅regret后的结构有误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: regret/remember/forget等动词后接动名词表“已发生的动作”，接不定式表“未发生的动作”，需根据语境区分。
